notablePrerequisites: You control three or more artifacts including an Equipment.
easyPrerequisites: You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
description:
Cast Cloud of Faeries by paying its mana cost.
When Cloud of Faeries enters, it triggers, untapping up to two lands.
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate an Equipment's equip ability given to it by Puresteel Paladin by paying {0}, targeting Cloud of Faeries.
Cowardice triggers, returning Cloud of Faeries from the battlefield to your hand.
The ability from step 4 fizzles due to having no valid target.
Repeat.
